description: Search recently published/updated Plano de Contratação Anual (PCA) entries — what public agencies INTEND to buy. Returns PCA entries (one per agency unit) with their items embedded. Filter by classification: 'material' or 'servico'. Defaults: last 30 days, classification 'material'. Per Lei 14.133. Maximum date range per query: 365 days (PNCP limit).

dataInicio.description: Start date YYYYMMDD. Default: 30 days ago.

name: search_pca
